title: Crepes with Maple Syrup & Butter
description: Golden, versatile crepes perfect for sweet or savoury cravings. Serve warm — simple is best.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, sugar, oil, milk, and flour until smooth and lump-free. The batter should be thin — the consistency of pouring cream.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Lightly oil the surface, then wipe off excess with paper towel.
Pour in a ladle of batter and swirl quickly to coat the pan thinly and evenly.
Cook until the edges lift and the top looks dry, about 30 seconds, then flip and cook the second side for 15–30 seconds.
Stack cooked crepes on a plate and cover with a clean tea towel to keep warm while you finish the batch.
Serve warm with your choice of toppings — Nutella, sliced banana, strawberries, honey, golden syrup, cream, or maple syrup.

notes.title: The First Crepe
notes.content: The first crepe is almost never perfect — it is the one that seasons the pan and helps you gauge the heat. Consider it a cook's snack and carry on.

notes.title: Batter Consistency
notes.content: The batter should be very thin, like pouring cream. If it is too thick, add a splash of milk. Letting the batter rest for 30 minutes improves the texture but is not essential.
